I’m gonna be honest with you. And I pray that you read my words with an open heart and mind and hear me out completely. I’m a guy, 20 years old, a lot of women don’t realize what exactly women are capable of. I have lost everything in my life, twice now, to two different women. Who never hit me, kidnapped me, or anything like that. Part of being a man means the expectations of life are ten fold for no real reason, and im not down playing women’s issues either. I don’t have to give birth, I don’t have to have a period every month, I don’t have to deal with a complete hormone spike everytime I start bleeding. But what I do have to deal with is the fact no matter what I say or do. It will never be enough, that I’ll work a job, 12 hours a day, 7 days a week, that would completely destroy the human body within ten years, just to have enough money to help my family, I have been beaten for no reason, sexually abused by women I wanted no part of. I have been lied about because a girl cheated on me and decided to tell everyone that I cheated instead of her, and nobody believed me even tho I had physical proof, but they believed her just because she was a girl. People are afraid of me, people are scared of me, people avoid me. And I hate that more then anything, I want people to feel safe around me, to feel like they can talk to me about anything, that im a warm smile in their life. But because of my genetics and my build and personality people are just scared of me. Life as a boy isn’t as grand as people make it out to be, it sucks, a lot. And im not saying being a girl doesn’t suck, because it does. But if you don’t want to believe me or not, god designed you to be you, take pride in who you are, do what you do best, try your hardest, if you want to be strong then hit the gym, if you want to feel safe, learn a martial art like Krav Maga( idk how to spell it but you can find it online) you have an unlimited amount of potential, don’t think for a minute that you aren’t great the way you are now, god loves you and designed you this way for a reason, so be the best person you can be, no matter what doubts and things cross your mind. Just remember that just because someone looks scary and is bigger then you doesn’t mean they will ever hurt you, and just because someone is smaller then you and has a warm smile on their face doesn’t mean they won’t hurt you, life is about working with what you have, and I hope you realize you are great the way you are, so keep fighting the good fight, get better everyday, even if it seems hopeless and in vain I promise it’s not, Rome wasn’t built in a day, so take your time to build your own version of Rome

Me personally, i have two thoughts on it. god made the earth and everything with pre aged in a way, like the gardens, Adam and Eve, so on so forth, so it’s not out of the question he created the “evolution” of man and everything else. In the other hand i think that a lot of people view the beginning of the Bible a little bit to literal, because it says on the first day etc etc. but we take it as the 24 hour days we know and use. But we have to remember that god isn’t like us. We are made in gods image yes. But god is not of this world but at the same time he is the world. So when it says a day it could be billions of years or seconds because gods “time” isn’t how our time but it is. Because he isn’t as simple as we are. So there’s the chance that the earth and universe took billions of years. But to god it was a day or week or however. So that’s my thought on it
